children: Oura’s in-vogue health trackers are driving 74% revenue growth as it pursues a listing. Hardware hiccups and competition with the likes of Apple may slow that pace. A $16 bln valuation is in reach, but it’s one befitting a gadget maker more than a high-flying digital platform.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Karen Kwok on LinkedIn and X.
Oura disclosed its IPO prospectus in an SEC filing on September 3. The company, which makes a health-tracking ring device, generated $1.2 billion in revenue for the nine months ended June 30, 2026.
Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Allen & Company and Jefferies are serving as lead bookrunners.
